cohort: 297 children aged 5-12 years with ADHD and 297 age-matched non-ADHD controls.
finding: Preterm birth, neonatal disease, high birth weight (>3500g), lower maternal education level, and fewer offspring were associated with increased risk of ADHD.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight in ADHD group: 3245.09g +/- 0.66g; control group: 3026.56g +/- 0.45g
